title: The 8 Best Compound Miter Saw 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for compound miter saw 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at compound miter saw 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: DEWALT 12 Inch Double Bevel Sliding Compound Miter Saw (DWS779)
products.blurb: Key specs: 15-amp motor, 12-inch blade, 14-inch horizontal cutting capacity.
strengths: 14-inch horizontal capacity handles wide stock without repositioning
Tall sliding fence supports crown molding upright for accurate nested compound cuts
Cam-lock miter detent mechanism clicks accurately to common angles
15-amp motor handles 12-inch blades through hardwood without bogging
limitations: Heavy at 56 lbs, not easy to move around the shop regularly
No laser guide, add-on available separately
features: Tall sliding fence supports crown and base molding
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: BOSCH GCM12SD 15 Amp 12 Inch Corded Dual-Bevel Sliding Glide Miter Saw with 60 Tooth Saw Blade & MS1234 Miter Saw Length Stop
products.blurb: Key specs: Axial-glide sliding mechanism, smaller footprint than rail-slide saws, 15-amp motor, Dual bevel, tilts left and right without flipping the workpiece.
strengths: Axial-glide mechanism needs only 3 inches of wall clearance vs 12+ for rail-slide saws
Dual bevel enables left and right tilts without repositioning crown molding
Electronic speed control maintains blade speed under load in hardwood
Lower table height than many competitors, better ergonomics at workbench height
limitations: Glide mechanism is complex and expensive to repair if damaged
features: Axial-glide sliding mechanism, smaller footprint than rail-slide saws
Dual bevel, tilts left and right without flipping the workpiece

products.name: Makita LS1019L 10" Dual-Bevel Sliding Compound Miter Saw with Laser
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-inch blade, Laser guide built-in, Dual bevel.
strengths: Built-in laser guide shows exact cut line, the best integrated laser on any saw
Direct-drive motor is quieter and requires less maintenance than belt-drive designs
Dual bevel handles crown and coped joints without workpiece repositioning
Makita engineering quality is excellent, accurate detents out of the box
limitations: 10-inch blade limits maximum cut depth vs 12-inch saws

products.name: CRAFTSMAN V20 Cordless Sliding Miter Saw, 7-1/4 inch, Single Bevel, Battery and Charger Included (CMCS714M1)
products.blurb: Key specs: 20V MAX cordless, battery and charger included, 7-1/4-inch blade, Single bevel.
strengths: Lowest price on this list for a sliding compound miter saw with battery included
Cordless operation, no cord to manage on job sites without power
Compact 7-1/4-inch size is lightweight and easy to carry
Sliding rail extends crosscut capacity beyond fixed-head compact saws
limitations: 7-1/4-inch blade limits cut depth compared to 10 or 12-inch saws
Single bevel only, no right-tilt without flipping the workpiece
features: 20V MAX cordless, battery and charger included
Sliding rail for extended crosscut capacity
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: SKIL MS6305-00 10-Inch Dual Bevel Sliding Compound Miter Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 15-amp motor, 10-inch blade, LED shadow line.
strengths: Dual bevel at the lowest price in the 12-inch segment
Laser guide included, helpful for cut alignment without marking each piece
15-amp motor handles standard woodworking materials
Simple setup, ready to cut out of the box
limitations: No sliding carriage, cut capacity limited to blade diameter
Fence quality lower than premium alternatives, check with a square before cutting trim

products.name: Metabo HPT C12RSH2 12-Inch Sliding Compound Miter Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 15.5-amp motor, 12-inch sliding capacity, Compact sliding design, reduced rear footprint.
strengths: Lighter than DEWALT DWS779, easier to move between sites
Compact rear slide design requires less wall clearance than standard rail-slide saws
15.5-amp motor is the highest amperage on this list, handles demanding cuts well
Laser guide built in at a competitive price
limitations: Metabo HPT brand (formerly Hitachi) less represented in service centers than DEWALT
Compact slide limits travel slightly compared to full-extension rail designs
features: Compact sliding design, reduced rear footprint

products.name: Festool 575306 Kapex KS 120 REB Sliding Compound Miter Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: Dust extraction port, minimal chip scatter, Dual bevel, Electronic motor control.
strengths: Dust extraction system captures the majority of chips, cleanest cut environment
Electronic motor control maintains exact blade speed regardless of load
Compact folding design collapses for transport, lightest 12V equivalent footprint
Festool quality: angles accurate out of the box, adjustments minimal
limitations: Extremely high price, difficult to justify outside of professional daily use
Festool proprietary system, dust port designed for Festool extractors
features: Dust extraction port, minimal chip scatter
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: WEN MM1015 15-Amp 10-Inch Dual Bevel Sliding Compound Miter Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 15-amp motor, 10-inch blade, Bevel up to 45 degrees.
strengths: Lowest price for a functional 10-inch compound miter saw
Built-in clamp holds workpieces during cuts without a separate accessory
Compact and lightweight, easy to move around a small shop
WEN brand provides accessible warranty service
